summary: The host_list inventory plugin parses a comma-separated host list string for non-path sources containing a comma.
questions: How does Ansible handle -i with a comma-separated list of hosts?

answer_card.title: host_list inventory plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.host_list` parses a comma-separated list of hosts. It only applies to inventory strings that aren't paths and contain a comma.
